source: The supplied Big Gaps report and follow-up propose that apostrophes, quotation marks or numbers produce an enlarged gap below their printed line. The source image coordinates are unavailable; this fixes new image rectangles and tests only six source-guided marker lines plus one comparison page.
row_extraction: Original 2400x3600 JPEG, grayscale <160, at least five dark pixels to mark one y row active, merge active runs across at most 14 fully blank pixel rows; measured gap is count of blank rows. Check threshold sensitivity at 100 and 200.
text_marker: On the aligned stored text line, ASCII apostrophe, ASCII double quote or ASCII digit, from raw and reviewed layers separately. A source-guided line may have multiple marker characters but counts as one marked line.
exclusions: Not a whole-book or random-sample punctuation association. Does not infer font software, a binary channel, causality or a specific LP2 decryption.
